Best Use of Adaption, 2026

How it works

Rules first,
then fit

Some postings rule you out before skill matters. Gradus checks those first.

→Keep

Nothing rules you out, and you meet what it asks for.

→Explore

Worth a look, but not a clean fit.

→Skip

A hard requirement rules you out.

01Eligibility

Adaption reads each posting into a requirement card. Rules check it against the profile before the model runs.

Requirement card, extracted by Adaption
GE Aerospace, Engines Co-op
Citizens onlyYes
Visa sponsorshipNone
DegreeBachelor’s or graduate, CS or related

Alex is on an F-1 visa, so this one is Skip. As a US citizen, Alex gets a Keep at 75%.
